result.summary: An external IP address (198.51.100.89) has been identified as attempting to probe and access unauthorized resources through the API Gateway. Multiple failed authentication and directory traversal attempts have been blocked.

confidence.rationale: The detection event ID (DET-SCAN-01) has a confidence score of 0.8, indicating strong evidence of the attack.
limitations: No direct evidence of successful compromise, only blocked attempts.

observedFacts.statement: 10 failed API key authentication requests from IP 198.51.100.89 against /vault/v1/secrets
15 failed token authentication attempts from IP 198.51.100.89
Directory traversal probe GET /../../etc/shadow from 198.51.100.89 returning 400 Bad Request
Unauthorized access attempt against /admin/keys from 198.51.100.89 blocked with 403 Forbidden

inferences.statement: The external IP address (198.51.100.89) is attempting to probe and access unauthorized resources through the API Gateway.
inferences.rationale: The observed facts indicate multiple failed authentication and directory traversal attempts, all of which were blocked by the API Gateway.

unknowns.statement: No evidence of successful compromise or unauthorized access has been found.
unknowns.significance: It is not clear if the external IP address has gained unauthorized access to the internal resources.
unknowns.recommendedTelemetry: Log source for user sessions or sessions associated with the external IP address.

attackProgression.description: Failed API key authentication attempts against /vault/v1/secrets

recommendedActions.rationale: Block the external IP address to prevent further unauthorized access attempts.
recommendedActions.expectedImpact: Containment of the attack by blocking the external IP address.
